label: Classic — Low key (chiaroscuro)
brief: Low key, chiaroscuro (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Low-key_lighting, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chiaroscuro): mostly dark tones and a strong contrast between a lit subject and a dark surround. The subject's highlights keep their detail; the background falls toward black. Lower exposure for the surround, then keep or lift the subject and deepen the background with the look's two masks, adjusted to this photo; a vignette may help. Deep shadows may clip a little: this look allows more black clipping than the default. If the photo has no clear lit subject, say so and suggest another look.
convergence_hints: stop when the lit subject holds the eye against a dark surround
stop when the subject's highlights keep their detail

masks.name: 1. Subject - Lift
masks.purpose: keep the lit subject bright against the dark surround

masks.name: 2. Background - Deepen
masks.purpose: let the surround fall toward black

checks.why: low key: the median tone sits below middle grey, in Zone III or lower
low key: the lit subject still reaches Zone VII
